subject: Post-call: OrchidAI discovery - schedule sizing & demo
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Reddy <priya@orchidai.com>, Samir Khan <samir.k@orchidai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Feb 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: OrchidAI discovery - schedule sizing & demo

Hi Priya / Samir —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the dedicated capacity sizing call and the technical demo: 

- Recap: OrchidAI plans to move inference for document parsing & extraction to a dedicated pool for predictable latency at scale. Target SLA: p95 < 120ms for short requests (<=256 tokens), sustained peak of ~220 QPS for the main extraction pipeline.
- Key open items: exact QPS distribution, token length percentiles, and whether KV cache/prefix caching will be applicable for your workflows.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
1) Dedicated sizing call (throughput & latency): 60 min — bring engineering + infra folks to review load profile.
2) Technical deep dive/demo: 45–60 min — runtime behavior, canary plan, and rollout controls.
3) Draft MAF (mutual action framework) and initial capacity estimate — we will circulate a draft after the sizing call.

Scheduling: I have two blocks open next week that would work for our capacity team: Wednesday 2028-03-07 09:00–10:00 PT or Thursday 2028-03-08 13:00–14:00 PT. If those don't work, please suggest 2x 1-hour windows and we'll accommodate.

Before the sizing call — could you share a rough load profile (QPS over time, token length distribution, typical concurrency, and any tail latency targets)? A simple CSV or a monitoring screenshot is fine. If useful, I've attached a short MAF template we can use.

Attachments: orchid-maf-draft.pdf (MAF template)

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: orchid-maf-draft.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Priya Reddy <priya@orchidai.com>

Cc: Samir Khan <samir.k@orchidai.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Feb 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: OrchidAI discovery - schedule sizing & demo

Thanks Soojin — great summary. Both Samir and I are available for the sizing call; engineering will join for the throughput numbers. 

Thursday 2028-03-08 13:00 PT works best for us. Can we also add our infra lead (Vikram Shah) to the call? I cc'd Samir here — Samir, can you confirm Vikram's email and I'll loop him in.

I'll attach a lightweight CSV with our QPS snapshot and token-length distribution before EOD tomorrow. Also adding a note: we use a mixture of short extraction (~80 tokens median) and longer context enrichments (~600 tokens) at lower frequency. Cache hit rate is unknown today.

Priya Reddy
Head of Platform, OrchidAI
priya@orchidai.com | +1 (650) 555-0147

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 29 Feb 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: OrchidAI discovery - schedule sizing & demo

Perfect — locking Thu 2028-03-08 13:00 PT for the sizing call and provisional technical demo for the following week (we'll confirm after the sizing session).

Action items from our side before the call:
- Ben will prepare a suggested Dedicated GPU pool configuration (expected GPU type, batch sizing, KV cache recommendations) based on the preliminary numbers you shared.
- Lauren will draft an initial rollout & canary checklist and note the telemetry we'll want to capture during the pilot.

Priya — when you send the CSV, please include any p95/p99 latency targets you have and an example peak-minute QPS. Even approximate buckets (e.g., 200 QPS sustained, 300 burst) are helpful.

[Quoted message removed for brevity]

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Soojin

From: Samir Khan <samir.k@orchidai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Priya Reddy <priya@orchidai.com>
Cc: Vikram Shah <vikram.shah@orchidai.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Feb 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: OrchidAI discovery - schedule sizing & demo

Thanks all — Vikram's email is vikram.shah@orchidai.com and he's looped here. I'm attaching the CSV snapshot of a busy hour and a brief note on request shape. The CSV has columns: timestamp, qps, median_tokens, p95_tokens, average_latency_ms. 

High-level callouts:
- Peak observed sustained QPS (5-min avg) ~ 220, with short bursts to ~340 for 30–60s.
- Median token length ~= 80; p95 token length ~= 620.
- Current p95 latency target: <= 120ms for short paths, allowance up to 400ms for enrichments.
- We do want a plan that minimizes cost but keeps p95 SLO for the short extraction path.

Attaching: orchid-load-profile.csv

See you on Thu 3/8.

Samir Khan
Sr. Engineering Manager, OrchidAI
samir.k@orchidai.com

[Attachment: orchid-load-profile.csv (text/csv)]
